servinfo.title: USB device connected to USB socket is not recognized by audio unit (if equipped)
servinfo.ptxt: Before performing the following troubleshooting, check if the symptom is not caused by incorrect handling while referring to Owner’s Manual.
If the cause cannot be identified by the following troubleshooting, replace audio unit with a known-good one. If the symptom is cleared, audio unit is the cause.

condition.ptxt: USB device connected to USB socket is not recognized by audio unit (if equipped)

ps.ptxt: Faulty USB and AUX harness connector

action.ptxt: Check USB and AUX harness connectors for connection.
Refer to USB and AUX Harness Inspection (If Equipped) .
Refer to USB and AUX Socket Inspection (If Equipped) .
Refer to Audio System Circuit Diagram and Inspection of Audio System and Its Circuit .
